title: Sukha Singh Is Redirected Toward Purposeful Martyrdom

blocks.text: An elder Singh intervenes to stop Sukha Singh from wasting his life in despair. He tells him to die fighting the Mughals if death is what he seeks, because martyrdom in service of the Panth is meaningful while self-destruction is not.

Sukha Singh accepts the rebuke and rejoins disciplined action. He enters the Khalsa ranks with renewed intention, resolving to strike the enemy cleverly and effectively rather than merely to advertise wounded pride.

The page closes with movement toward Lahore. What began as shame is transformed into vocation, and the restless energy of the young Singh is redirected into service, daring, and calculated resistance.
